title: Crew wake, Aashaan out and back, Suresh and Balan come up
subtitle: Two 8 s shots, one locked aft camera, keyframes edited from the approved take · Ranjith, 2026-11-12

panels.title: Bow: Antony points at the fire
beats: Your bow take ends with Antony at the bow pointing left at the burning vallam, 500 m off.
He runs aft along the left rail (behind the camera in the next view).

panels.title: K1 start: all asleep, Aashaan at the wheel
beats: 0–1.5 s still beat. 1.5–3 s Antony runs in from behind the camera on the right, crouches by Babu.
3 s Babu jerks up; 4.5 s Raghavan sits up (towel at neck); 6 s Sasi lifts his head; Aashaan turns at the wheel.

panels.title: K2: woken
beats: End of s23-sh02b = start of s23-sh02c. No moon in the aft sky (L142).

panels.title: K3 end: up; Aashaan out of the door
beats: 0–2 s Antony points out; Babu to the rail nearest the camera. 2–4 s Raghavan up. 4–5.5 s Aashaan steps out, wheel empty.
5.5–8 s Sasi up. Faces to the right (fire behind the camera). Next: s23-sh03 v5, s23-sh04 v3.

panels.title: Aashaan back to the wheel; Suresh and Balan come up
beats: Start = s23-sh02c last frame. 0–2.5 s Raghavan, Sasi reach the rail; Aashaan goes back in. 2.5–3.5 s Aashaan at the wheel.
3.5–5.5 s Suresh steps out, sleepy; 5.5–8 s Balan behind him, alert. Silent.
